description: P1-robust pre-registered thresholds, variants and input contract (docs/P1_ROBUST_EXTENSION_PLAN.md §3.4, §4). Frozen once U-02 merges; U-03 refuses a file whose sha256 differs from the U-02 summary. No value was tuned on ground truth.

anchor_band.source: delta1 accuracy band of the project depth metric (docs/EXPERIMENTS.md §4.2); flag A2 fires when |log a_f| > log(anchor_band)

min_anchor_inlier_ratio.source: merged runs/mapping_run.py DEFAULT_CONFIG min_inlier_ratio; flag A1 when the per-frame estimate_scale fails

min_anchor_inliers.source: merged runs/mapping_run.py DEFAULT_CONFIG min_inliers; flag A1 when the per-frame estimate_scale fails

min_coverage_bins.source: merged runs/mapping_run.py DEFAULT_CONFIG min_coverage_bins (of 4x4 = 16 bins); flag A4 when calibration-inlier coverage is lower

min_withheld_pairs.source: merged alignment/causal.py rule check.any(): flag A3 is evaluated only with at least one withheld pair

residual_threshold_m.source: merged runs/mapping_run.py DEFAULT_CONFIG residual_threshold_m (the global gate); flag A3 when the withheld median |residual| is larger

tracking_ok_state.source: Y-01 contract src/rt_mapping/contracts/slam.py STATES; flag S1 when a known state differs, unavailable when no tracking export exists

evaluation_only_u03: TUM sequence directory and dataset manifest via evaluation.oracle.load_oracle_inputs
gt_free: slam run: sparse snapshot via runs.artifacts.load_mapping_inputs; tracking export when listed

variants.description: unchanged public run_mapping with the recorded mapping config (only plot may differ)
variants.name: P1-global-control

variants.description: every keyframe depth multiplied by its a_f where a_f exists; frames with null a_f stay uncorrected
variants.name: P1-anchored

variants.description: P1-anchored with every gate-rejected keyframe left out of fusion
